Can I do this myself? Yes! That's the beauty of our simple DIY roofing system. Step-by-step videos and PDF's are on our installation page .
How much can I really save by doing it myself? Labor is often one of the biggest costs in roofing. Do it yourself and you get a seamless roof at a fraction of the cost — saving thousands or more. Check out our Kit Builder to learn more.
Do contractors use Crazy Seal? Absolutely! Contractors love that it is quick and simple to install, solves thousands of different roofing problems, and comes with a 50 year warranty — a real, lasting solution for their clients.
What will my roofing system cost? Very affordable — especially compared to alternatives that include labor. Visit our Kit Builder for the cost of your specific project.
What kinds of roofs can Crazy Seal be applied to? Fiberglass, rubber / EPDM, TPO, metal, wood, or virtually any other type of roof. Videos and PDF's for each are on Installation .
Does your roof system work on all RV's? Yes, the Crazy Seal system is compatible with all types of RVs, motorhomes, 5th wheels, travel trailers, pop-ups, park models, and semi-trailers.
How long does it take to install a Crazy Seal System? It depends on the size of the job. Most people get the first coat of Crazy Seal on within a few hours of receiving their kit — faster if you have watched our installation tutorials and done some prep work in advance. Watch the time-lapse video below to see the entire system applied to an RV roof.
Is this like the "rubber in a can" products I can buy at the store? No. Crazy Seal (patented) is a high performance, commercial grade, fiber-infused silicone membrane roofing system. Big box store products in a can are usually temporary solutions. Crazy Seal lets you custom manufacture your new roof on site, rather than in sheets at a factory, eliminating seams and exposed sealants. Do it right and do it once!
How much does the warranty cost? Nothing! It's included. Details on our 50 year, fully transferable warranty can be found on our warranty page .
What happens if I receive product damaged during shipping? Any package(s) that are damaged during shipment need to be reported to Crazy Seal support within 24 hours of delivery. Crazy Seal is not responsible for shipping damage reported outside of that time frame. We ship with FedEx and have protocols in place to get you fresh product quickly, but they are only valid with our shipping company if notified of damage in a certain time window. Please email us with photos of the damaged shipment at support@crazyseal.com within 24 hours of delivery.
What is your return policy? Products must be returned within 90 days of purchase. The customer is responsible for all shipping costs incurred with returns. Please return your products with your order information to: Crazy Seal Products, Inc. Shipping Facility | 301 Walnut Springs Rd. | Lindale, TX 75771. There is a 20% restocking fee on all returned orders. Once your return is received to the facility, we will process a refund after subtracting 20% for the restocking fee.

I am a 3rd generation roofer. My Grandfather (also Lee Thaxton) started Thaxton Roofers, Inc. in Northfield, Ohio back in 1946, and my Uncle and Cousin still run that business today. My father was a roofing contractor, and my brother, uncles and cousins are in the business too.

Thaxton is a derivative of Thatcher, or Thatch for short. Thatching literally means roofing: “a material, as straw, rushes, leaves, or the like, used to cover roofs.”
With over 70 years of experience behind us, we know a thing or two about roofing. Although I love my family, I've always leaned towards innovation and creating new paths. While I can appreciate traditional roofing, as it's been a mainstay in our family for decades, I ventured out.
Lee Thaxton, 3rd from left, 1982
No RV'er Left Behind
Carol and I are fellow RV'ers. We travel most of the year in our motorhome and work from the road. It's a great way to see this great country, and with internet virtually anywhere, it's easy to stay on top of our businesses.

The first nationwide, mobile service company offering a seamless, maintenance free roofing system

Solvent based
Needs primer
Needs trained, certified techs
So we made something different, something special, for the average DIY'er — not the inferior products you find at most retailers. We spent years working with chemical specialists until we found and tested a formula that would stand the test of time.

Crazy Seal is the most advanced fluid applied roofing membrane ever developed: a patented, superior grade fiber-infused silicone. Its 3 products (Crazy Caulk, Crazy Patch, and Crazy Seal) work together to create an incredibly tough, seamless, maintenance free roof membrane.

Yes! That's the beauty of our simple DIY roofing system. Step-by-step videos and PDF's are on our installation page . How much can I really save by doing it myself? Labor is often one of the biggest costs in roofing. Do it yourself and you get a seamless roof at a fraction of the cost — saving thousands or more. Check out our Kit Builder to learn more. Do contractors use Crazy Seal? Absolutely! Contractors love that it is quick and simple to install, solves thousands of different roofing problems, and comes with a 50 year warranty — a real, lasting solution for their clients. What will my roofing system cost? Very affordable — especially compared to alternatives that include labor. Visit our Kit Builder for the cost of your specific project. What kinds of roofs can Crazy Seal be applied to? Fiberglass, rubber / EPDM, TPO, metal, wood, or virtually any other type of roof. Videos and PDF's for each are on Installation . Does your roof system work on all RV's? Yes, the Crazy Seal system is compatible with all types of RVs, motorhomes, 5th wheels, travel trailers, pop-ups, park models, and semi-trailers. How long does it take to install a Crazy Seal System? It depends on the size of the job. Most people get the first coat of Crazy Seal on within a few hours of receiving their kit — faster if you have watched our installation tutorials and done some prep work in advance. No. Crazy Seal (patented) is a high performance, commercial grade, fiber-infused silicone membrane roofing system. Big box store products in a can are usually temporary solutions. Crazy Seal lets you custom manufacture your new roof on site, rather than in sheets at a factory, eliminating seams and exposed sealants. Do it right and do it once! How much does the warranty cost? Nothing!
